corpus_source: official full BEIR NFCorpus corpus; no qrel-based sampling

threshold_calibration.model: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=10), predicts nonnegative Recall@100 escalation gain

protocol_note: Router and threshold were frozen from SciFact train-only data before NFCorpus test scoring. This measures cross-dataset transfer; it does not recalibrate on NFCorpus.
